content: Smithland Lock and Dam is located on the Ohio River in Kentucky, near the town of Smithland in Livingston County. It is part of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers navigation system on the Ohio River. The lock and dam helps maintain a consistent navigation pool level and allows river traffic to pass through by raising or lowering vessels through the lock chamber. It was constructed as part of the Ohio River navigation improvement projects in the mid-20th century.
